Accomplishment
1. Directed the staff in preparing Long-Range Regional Development Plan and carrying our various community and regional analyses.

2. Established Regional Geographic Information System and Regional Foreign Trade Zone.

3. Established the first in the nation a multi-county Juvenile Secure Detention Facility.

4. Leading the New York State Capital District Regional Planning Committee to win the National Association of Regional Planning Committee "Outstanding Regional Achievement First Prize" 1998

5. Advisor of the Overseas Compatriot Affairs Council (Taiwan) 僑務委員會諮詢委員 2010-

6. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 08/2018

Publication (Non-professional)
1. 八十自述:哈得遜河畔隨筆(English version: On the Banks of Hudson River-My American Journey) 2015/05

Hobby
Reading world history、Golf、Tennis、Traveling

Notable Accomplishments

Directed the staff in preparing Long-Range Regional Development Plan and carrying out various community and regional analyses.

Established Regional Geographic Information System and Regional Foreign Trade Zone.

Established the first in the nation a multi-county Juvenile Secure Detention Facility.

Led the New York State Capital District Regional Planning Committee to win the National Association of Regional Planning Committee 'Outstanding Regional Achievement First Prize' 1998.

Advisor of the Overseas Compatriot Affairs Council (Taiwan) 僑務委員會諮詢委員 2010-

Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 08/2018.
